foreign_photos.shows: A BROWN pipe bowl (mottled brown/grey patina, carved ear-like relief on the side) with a hinged gilt lid and a hallmarked gilt rim plate; does not match the CREAM/ivory bowl with pierced gilt gallery in the sheet image AMB-A-001-1
Same brown carved bowl as -3 (hinged gilt lid, gilt guilloche ferrule on the shank); different bowl colour/texture and different gilt mounts from the cream bowl in -1
Closed Boulle-style box (brass/pewter scroll inlay); nothing in any photo links it to the pipe or to the red velvet case in -1 (unverified rather than proven foreign)

description_problem: The text is built from -1 (cream bowl, pierced gilt cover, amber stem in red velvet) plus the box in -2, but photos -3/-4 in the same folder show a brown bowl with hinged gilt lid: «غليون برأس كريمي يتدرّج إلى العسلي وغطاء مخرّم» contradicts -3/-4, and «يرافقه صندوق مطعّم» is not supported (box shown closed and separately). Owner must decide which pipe AMB-A-001 is.
notes_problem: Notes treat all four photos as one pipe: «أربع دمغات صغيرة على حافة الرأس» refers to the brown bowl in -3/-4, while «الرأس يبدو من الميرشوم» fits only the cream bowl in -1. These look like two different pipes.
new_description: غليون بمبسم من الكهرمان وغطاء معدني مزخرف، قطعة نفيسة من أدوات التدخين.
what_it_is_en: Pipe with amber-tipped stem; folder appears to mix two different pipe bowls plus an unlinked closed box
problems: Sheet image -1 is a partial crop (top of bowl + stem), not a full view; no photo shows either pipe complete. Bowl colour differs clearly: -1 cream/ivory matte with honey base vs -3/-4 brown with patina and a carved relief; gilt mounts also differ (pierced lattice gallery in -1 vs gadrooned hinged lid with palmette in -3/-4). New description kept neutral (amber mouthpiece + decorated metal cover).
